messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands security segment - customers want a short timeline and a clear list of deliverables for SOC2/ISO, BYOK (EU), and the private VPC control plane.

 tara (Security): top-line: SOC2 evidence automation and an auditor-friendly evidence pack is highest priority this quarter. BYOK (key import + integration) is planned next (EU-first beta), and the private VPC control plane GA is later in the roadmap. i’ll add bullets to the follow-up doc.

 samir: for audit logs: can we confirm export formats and retention options? buyers asked specifically about S3 snapshots and syslog streaming, plus retention >=1 year.

 dev-platform: building export connectors: daily S3 snapshot, syslog/webhook streaming (rfc5424), and an archive tier. retention configurable per-org via console and API. beta early next month. sample command: `redwood audit export --org acme --dest s3://acme-exports --from 2026-04-01 --to 2026-04-30`.

 maria: will exported logs redact PII by default? auditors sometimes request unredacted data.

 tara (Security): default exports redact PII. we provide an audited unredacted bundle workflow for auditors (requires NDA + approvals and full access logging). all downloads are recorded.

 dave (Sales): can we get language for RFPs? procurement keeps asking which controls map to SOC2 vs ISO and what gaps exist.

 tara (Security): deliverables: (1) one-page control matrix (SOC2 <-> ISO mapping), (2) evidence pack template (auditor-friendly), (3) auditor access workflow, and (4) BYOK FAQ. targets: one-pager draft next week, evidence pack by end of Q2.

 samir: BYOK rotation story? emergency revoke?

 tara (Security): two modes: managed keys (we auto-rotate) and customer-imported keys (rotation is customer-controlled). we’ll provide rotation APIs/CLI and emergency-revoke workflows with audit trails.

 dev-platform: engineering note: BYOK in EU will require provenance linking key imports to orgs and HSM metadata; we’re adding instrumentation for that.

 compliance-bot: @maria created COMP-722: "SOC2/ISO one-pager + evidence pack + BYOK & VPC FAQ" assigned to @maria and @tara, due 2026-05-12.

 maria: will draft the one-pager and post to #docs by EOD Friday; solutions-eng can review for procurement phrasing.

 olivia: tara, can you paste the roadmap bullets into the all-hands follow-up doc so i can include them in the summary email?

 tara (Security): will post a 5-bullet summary in ~30 minutes and tag leadership.:+1:

 dave (Sales): thanks — this will help with renewals and new RFP responses.

 olivia: great thread. thanks everyone.
